g.text: 1. Parse the page with BeautifulSoup (lxml parser)
2. Remove script, style, nav, header, footer, form, noscript
3. Remove SRM page-builder blocks: icon lists, tabs, breadcrumbs
5. Take the visible text, one block per line
1. Open the PDF with PyMuPDF; read text page by page, in order
2. Count every line; remove lines of ≤ 100 characters that
appear 3 or more times (running page headers and footers)
Runs once per policy in data/manifest.yaml (6 documents)
